bug.title: The KS guard compares every node's realised IC, so genuine real-node edge and child pseudo-replication read as "detectable nulls" and void calibrated campaigns
bug.symptoms: The guard sample is every evaluated node's ic_mean, split by root label. On a window where real signals have power, the real side is a mixture of edge plus noise and the null side is noise, so KS rejects even when the null is a perfect stand-in for "no edge". Children of the root a policy chose to refine also inflate one side. archT2 was VOID at p 0.013; its four sibling campaigns gave 0.08, 0.42, 0.21 and 0.12.
bug.reproduction_steps: Close out a synthetic campaign with 25 null roots (IC ~ N(0, s)) and 140 real roots, 40% of which carry a true IC of 0.05, plus children copied from the top roots. The guard voids it, although the nulls are exactly "no edge".
bug.expected: - The gating sample is one value per root, never per node. Each null root and real root contributes its own ic_mean (the root node's own evaluation). Children are excluded from the gate. - The gate compares roots without detectable edge on both sides. Only roots with |ic_tstat| < DISCOVERY_TSTAT enter, and the same truncation is applied to both labels, so "no edge vs no edge" is tested. That is the comparison the permutation scheme governs. - With fewer than KS_MIN_SAMPLE on a side after filtering, the gate is not computed: calibration_status "insufficient", which is not VOID and not ok. It is documented. - The previous all-node statistic is still computed and persisted as a diagnostic. CloseoutResult and the JSON line gain: - ks_pvalue_all_nodes - ks_variant = "root-nonsig" for the gate - ks_root_counts as (n_null, n_real) after filtering - The persisted VOID decision follows the gate only. - The rule, and why, is stated in the module docstring, citing PRD §4.3 and this spec. - test_closeout_ks_root_level.py covers: - the reproduction above is ok, not VOID, while the diagnostic statistic still rejects - a leaking null (null roots' IC systematically offset, inside the non-significant band) is still VOID - children are excluded from the gate - the "insufficient" path - the truncation is applied to both sides It passes under pytest-xdist. The orchestrator member suite and root tests/ pass, including tests/e2e/test_planted_null_ks_guard.py (updated only if it pins the old all-node sample; its intent of catching a detectable null is kept).
bug.actual: Root cause: the guard's sample is realised outcome IC over all nodes, which mixes genuine edge and correlated children into the detectability test.
bug.constraints: nulloracle's KS test itself is unchanged; only close-out's choice of sample changes No file outside the two listed is edited Do not edit docs/user-journeys/
